use.title: 1. Use of the service
use.body: WeRide offers rentals of electric micromobility vehicles. By using the app you agree to use the service responsibly and to follow traffic rules and local signage.

account.title: 2. Your account
account.body: You are responsible for your account information and for keeping your password private. Tell us if you suspect unauthorized use.

rides.title: 3. Bookings and rides
rides.body: Each booking is tied to a vehicle and a station. A ride starts when you unlock the vehicle and set your destination, and ends when you finish it in the app. Changing the destination during a ride may carry a fee.

payments.title: 4. Payments
payments.body: A ride's amount depends on the vehicle's per-minute rate and the actual duration. Amounts shown before the ride are estimates.

liability.title: 5. Liability
liability.body: You must return the vehicle in good condition and report any problem through the app. WeRide is not liable for misuse of the service.

data.title: 1. Data we collect
data.body: We collect your account data (email and profile), your bookings and rides, and the location needed to show nearby vehicles and record your ride route.

purpose.title: 2. How we use it
purpose.body: We use your data to provide the service, calculate ride costs, show your history and improve the app.

sharing.title: 3. Who we share it with
sharing.body: We do not sell your data. It is only shared with providers needed to run the service, such as maps and hosting.

rights.title: 4. Your rights
rights.body: You can view and edit your profile in the app and request deletion of your account from Settings.
